title: Window Hopper - Supports selecting window with the mouse

status.label: Clear interaction design candidate
status.detail: The request narrowly asks for mouse selection of a visible Window Hopper target, analogous to Alt+Tab.

next_action.label: Design pointer selection
next_action.reason: The requested interaction is specific and can be scoped against Window Hopper's existing keyboard cycle UI.

actions.label: Design mouse selection for Window Hopper
actions.note: Define hover, click, focus, dismissal, and keyboard-accessibility behavior for selecting a Window Hopper target. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The enhancement has one concrete interaction goal and does not require additional reporter evidence before design exploration.
evidence: The body asks for selecting a Window Hopper window with the mouse.
The comparison point is the mouse-selectable Alt+Tab interface.
The request explicitly contrasts pointer selection with the current hotkey-only cycling.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a focused Window Hopper interaction design covering pointer hit targets, activation, focus, dismissal, and accessibility.
